hints.title: Adjacent Bit Parity Inversion
hints.text: In an alternating binary sequence, every pair of adjacent bits differs. Shifting the number rightward by one bit aligns opposite bits against one another.

hints.title: All Ones Exclusive Disjunction Invariant
hints.text: Combining n with n shifted right by one bit via exclusive disjunction produces a unbroken sequence of ones if and only if adjacent bits were strictly alternating.

hints.title: Power Of Two Increment Verification Procedure
hints.text: Let x equal n bitwise exclusive-ored with n shifted right by one bit. If all bits of x are ones, then adding one to x produces a power of two with a single high bit. Verify that x conjoined with x plus one equals zero. Return true if zero, false otherwise.

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(1) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: String conversion or iterative modulo checks take O(log N) operations and perform repeated divisions.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Bitwise manipulation achieves O(1) time and O(1) space with two machine instructions.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should demonstrate the x & (x + 1) == 0 property for all-ones bitmasks or write clean bit-shift checks.
